title: Ansible@13: pyasn1 has quadratic CPU use in schemaless BER/CER/DER container decoding (CVE-2026-119194)
description: CVE-2026-119194 is a high-severity vulnerability in pyasn1 used by Ansible@13 (version 13.7.0 and later). It causes quadratic CPU usage when decoding attacker-controlled schemaless BER, CER, or DER data with many distinct long tag IDs, potentially leading to denial of service by exhausting CPU resources. The flaw arises from inefficient handling of TagSet insertions during decoding. No confidentiality or integrity impacts were observed.
